facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia, which is onboarding more banks and fintechs, reported continued growth in use of Pay Na-Na, the national instant payment platform launched in December 2025, per Governor Saamoi.

LBR.note: No digital-skills training for civil servants is stated.
No consumer-protection rules or complaints body are stated.
No cross-border corridor or regional link is stated.

facts.fact: Government-to-person payments were prioritised on the Pay Na-Na platform as a deliberate policy choice, per Central Bank of Liberia governor Saamoi.

LBR.note: No survey share of adults with an account is given.

facts.fact: Pay Na-Na, Liberia's national instant payment platform, launched in December 2025 and the Central Bank of Liberia reports continued growth in transactions and usage.

LBR.note: No payment of taxes or fees is stated.
